result.title: Qodo brings company context into Codex code review
result.description:
Qodo’s Codex plugin brings company context, codebase standards, and independent review into the development workflow. It helps developers catch bugs across repositories, where a change can look right in one codebase and break a service in another.

In Behind the Build, co-founder Itamar Friedman and AI DevRel lead Nnenna Ndukwe discuss how they’re building with GPT-6 Astra and their vision for a workflow where one agent writes code and another challenges it.

Read the full story: https://openai.com/index/qodo-codex-plugin/
